北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京寒意浓，体感 -10℃，记得多穿点哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold, feels like -10℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，能见度低，出门慢行，注意保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 1℃，微凉，记得添衣别着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 1℃, a bit chilly. Remember to add clothes!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 10℃，体感微凉，出门带件外套吧。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, 10℃. It feels cool, bring a jacket.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，微风拂面，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with a light breeze. Mind the temperature change.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 -2℃，地面湿滑，出行注意安全哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear, feels like -2℃. Roads might be slick, stay safe!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -2℃，风力 2级，早晚温差大，记得多穿点。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -2℃ with a 2-level breeze. Dress warmly for big temperature swings.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella and stay dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 -3℃，路滑，出行小心，注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and slick, feels like -3℃. Drive carefully and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 -3℃，阳光虽好，保暖别忽视哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear, feels like -3℃. Enjoy the sun, but don't forget to stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 9℃，注意适时添减衣物，保持舒适。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 9℃. Adjust your clothing to stay comfortable.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -27℃，大雾弥漫，出行务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -27℃ with dense fog. Bundle up completely when going out!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -21℃，寒风凛冽，出门多加几层衣物哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -21℃ with a biting wind. Layer up well before going out!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，湿度高，体感 3℃，记得带件暖和外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with high humidity, feels like 3℃. Bring a warm jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温 12℃，体感舒适，记得享受好天气！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, 12℃, and feels pleasant. Enjoy the good weather!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -3℃，风力 3级，海风寒冷，务必做好防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -3℃ with a level 3 wind. The sea breeze is cold, keep warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 0℃，早晚凉意浓，记得加件外套。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast, feels like 0℃. It's chilly morning and night, wear a jacket.
